Subject: Request: DPF questionnaire + DPA annex mapping and clarifications

Hi Laura —

Thanks for taking this on. Our legal/privacy team had a quick pass and asked for the following materials so we can close the RFP privacy review by 17 Sep: 

- An annotated DPF / Data Protection Framework questionnaire (showing where Redwood maps to each control)
- A DPA annex mapping spreadsheet (explicit mapping to SCCs/DPF clauses)
- Network/dataflow diagram showing EU processing boundaries and any US-bound routes
- KMS/key custody options and short notes on BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys
- Confirmation of audit log retention windows and SIEM integration points

Can you confirm you can provide these by end-of-day Thu (14 Sep)? If any of the above needs clarification on our side, say so and we’ll respond fast.

Thanks,
Alice Monroe
Senior Privacy Counsel
Hospicure Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: DPF questionnaire + DPA annex mapping and clarifications

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We’ll put together an annotated DPF and a DPA annex mapping file plus a dataflow diagram. 

Quick clarifying Q from our side: will Hospicure consider the SOC2/SIEM logs and a 90-day audit retention window acceptable as a default, or do you need a longer retention period in the environment for procurement? Also, does the dataset include direct patient identifiers (PHI) or only pseudonymized patient tokens? The answer will affect the redaction guidance we include.

Timeline: we’ll circulate an internal draft by EOD Wed (13 Sep) and final attachments by EOD Thu (14 Sep). If that works, I’ll include the DPA annex mapping + options for EU-only processing and our BYOK flow.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Principal, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Hospicure DPF artifacts (technical clarifications)

Short answers for the packet:

- EU-only processing: yes — for Dedicated and Private we can pin processing to EU regions; hosted API can be region-restricted per contract and routing policies.
- Encryption in transit: TLS1.2+ with modern ciphers; at rest: AES-256.
- KMS options: 1) Customer-managed KMS via supported cloud KMS (BYOK/HSM), 2) Redwood-managed KMS with bring-your-own-key rotation support, 3) Hybrid where data encryption keys are wrapped by customer key.
- SIEM / audit logs: event types include authentication, model-inference requests (headers/metadata only, not full prompts unless customer opts in), configuration changes, key rotation events; default retention 90 days; can extend under enterprise contract.
- Subprocessor locations: yes — ops will produce a CSV (region, provider, role).

Attachment: technical_notes_stub.txt (we’ll include full export in the ZIP).

Ben Carter
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Deliverables: Annotated DPF, DPA annex mapping, and dataflow diagram (Hospicure)

Hi Alice — attaching the materials we discussed. Summary below and next steps.

Attachments (zipped for delivery):
- DPF_annotated_answers_v1.pdf (annotated responses; each control maps to policy + evidence stub)
- DPA_Annex_Mapping_Hospicure.xlsx (clause-level mapping to SCCs and operational controls)
- redwood_dataflow_diagram_v2.png (region-aware diagram; shows EU-only processing option and optional US fallback with pseudonymization)
- KMS_options_summary.docx (BYOK/HSM and implementation notes)

Key notes:
- EU-only processing: For Dedicated and Private deployments we can guarantee processing within EU regions and provide a technical enforcement plan in the annex.
- Hosted API: routing policies can prefer EU endpoints; fallbacks to non-EU regions can be disabled under contract.
- Keys: we support customer-managed KMS (BYOK/HSM) and Redwood-managed KMS; key wrapping options and HSM-backed custody are documented in KMS_options_summary.docx.
- Logs: default SIEM/audit retention is 90 days; longer retention is available as an add-on and can be specified in the DPA annex.

Links: full packet in shared drive — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDRIVE_HOSPICURE_SAMPLE
DocuSign (DPA annex template) — https://app.docusign.com/templates/hosted/ZXCVB-DocuSign-Hospicure

Next steps: please confirm which deployment mode you plan to procure (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and any variations to the retention or key custody requirements. If you’re comfortable with this package we can route the DPA annex for signatures and push the subprocessor CSV.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Principal, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
